requirements: Target independent and score blind before immutable pitch-set evidence sealing.
Preserve source-domain event identity/provenance separately from availability time.
Browser-local bounded execution with one acoustic perception owner; any ORT subordinate Worker taxonomy must be explicit and asset-bound.
No transport authority, Pause/Resume authority, target advance or correctness decision inside acoustic perception.
Improved polyphonic octave localization must preserve legitimate octave chords, not collapse pitch classes.
Extra-pitch precision must be evaluated together with full-chord recall and extra/missing-tone safety negatives.
Candidate design must publish a new immutable identity for any changed model, decoder, thresholds, postprocessor, geometry or assembly; never mutate the historical Robust identity.
Keep the actual one-target/one-attempt/one-verdict product runtime as verdict owner; capacity=1, strict eventTime>inputEligibleAfter, equality rejected, no queue or cross-target reassignment.
Demonstrate browser feasibility and bounded ownership separately from musical recognition; no fallback model/runtime path.
No claim of a perfect physical-strike detector or a scientific winner.

prohibitedHeuristicRepairs.name: target-conditioned pitch filtering
prohibitedHeuristicRepairs.reason: Hides unexpected physical notes before verification and violates score blindness.

prohibitedHeuristicRepairs.name: target-cardinality top-K
prohibitedHeuristicRepairs.reason: Uses expected score size to suppress acoustic competitors; extra physical pitches can disappear.

prohibitedHeuristicRepairs.name: target subset acceptance
prohibitedHeuristicRepairs.reason: Allows expected subset to MATCH a larger performed chord, directly weakening extraToneFalseMatch safety.

prohibitedHeuristicRepairs.name: ignore any extra pitch if target is present
prohibitedHeuristicRepairs.reason: Discards the very evidence that distinguishes a wrong extra-tone gesture from exact support.

prohibitedHeuristicRepairs.name: global octave deduplication
prohibitedHeuristicRepairs.reason: The legitimate [46,58] octave chord must retain both absolute pitches; non-octave D3/D5 errors are not fixed by deduplication.

prohibitedHeuristicRepairs.name: confidence threshold fitted on v9
prohibitedHeuristicRepairs.reason: Wrong E3/G#4 confidences exceed a true G#3 confidence; high-confidence D3/D5 false pitches also occur. No simple higher cutoff is supported.

prohibitedHeuristicRepairs.name: pitch-class-only matching
prohibitedHeuristicRepairs.reason: Conflates distinct absolute pitches and changes wrong-octave safety semantics.

detectorReason: V9 did not establish a strike-detector root cause. No new inference gate or independent detector is authorized.
developmentSelectionRequirement: A separately authorized phase must prospectively bound candidate identities/budget, development comparison criteria and stop rules. No candidate, threshold or model is selected in v10.
productTruthSemantics: Complete normalized absolute attack pitch-set equality; MATCH requires exact full physical truth support, not subset or pitch-class support.
semanticChangeBoundary: Any proposed change to exact-set product semantics requires a separate product-design proposal, revised safety model and wholly fresh prospective holdout; it cannot be hidden inside an acoustic fix.
